findings.title: DSCR YEAR 1: 1.97
findings.priority_rule: GOOD_TO_FIX: informational DSCR figure, no threshold breached.
findings.explanation: Computed from the document's own net profit, depreciation, interest and repayment figures for this year. The document itself states a DSCR of 1.58 for this year. The difference from our standard-formula figure usually means the document's own convention does not add interest back into the numerator -- not that either figure is wrong. Confirm which convention the lender expects.
findings.suggested_action: No action needed from this figure alone.

findings.dedup_key: financial_calculation|fuel cost does not match acres x litres/acre x price|8
findings.title: Fuel cost does not match acres x litres/acre x price
findings.priority_rule: MUST_FIX: fuel_cost_reconciliation discrepancy is 26.7% of the stated total, at/above the 5% threshold.
findings.explanation: Acres x litres/acre x price/litre = 9.12 lakh; the document states 7.2 lakh.
findings.suggested_action: Verify this figure with the applicant.

findings.priority_rule: MUST_FIX: crew_wage_reconciliation discrepancy is 37.5% of the stated total, at/above the 5% threshold.
findings.explanation: Annexure staffing plan totals 3.3 lakh; the P&L states 2.4 lakh.
findings.suggested_action: Verify this figure with the applicant.

findings.dedup_key: financial_calculation|fund flow sources do not match applications|12
findings.title: Fund flow sources do not match applications
findings.priority_rule: MUST_FIX: fund_flow_sources_applications_balance discrepancy is 64.6% of the stated total, at/above the 5% threshold.
findings.explanation: Sources of funds - Applications of funds (a nonzero result must appear as closing cash in the cash-flow statement, not be plugged away) Sources 102.65 lakh, applications 62.36 lakh, gap 40.29 lakh.
findings.suggested_action: Verify this figure with the applicant.

findings.dedup_key: assumption|claimed annual acreage exceeds plausible machine throughput|4
findings.title: Claimed annual acreage exceeds plausible machine throughput
findings.priority_rule: MUST_FIX: acres_per_year_feasibility discrepancy is 50.0% of the stated total, at/above the 5% threshold.
findings.explanation: Acres/day x operating days/season x seasons/year = 600 acres/year; the document plans for 1200.
findings.suggested_action: Verify this figure with the applicant.
